Maverick Browser

Share a platform tab, or open a dedicated tab and let the agent choose where to go.

Checking the selected tab…

Agent tab supports Instagram, X, Reddit, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube. It can navigate, read and analyze content. Posting, messaging and form entry are not available.

Keep the Browser window open. Captures may bring your shared tab to the foreground. Cookies and passwords are not sent to Maverick. You can revoke sharing at any time.
